question_stem: A car of mass $1800\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $300\text{ kg}$ up a straight road inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin \alpha = 0.05$. The car and trailer are connected by a tow-bar which is light and rigid and is parallel to the road. There is a resistance force of $800\text{ N}$ acting on the car and a resistance force of $F\text{ N}$ acting on the trailer. The driving force of the car's engine is $3000\text{ N}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
It is given that $F = 100$.

Find the acceleration of the car and the tension in the tow-bar.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
It is given instead that the total work done against $F$ in moving a distance of $50\text{ m}$ up the road is $6000\text{ J}$. The speed of the car at the start of the $50\text{ m}$ is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

Use an energy method to find the speed of the car at the end of the $50\text{ m}$.
